title: Pre-call brief data
description: The #brief-data block of a precall-brief page. scripts/precall_brief_build.py validates against this file (a stdlib subset: type, required, properties, additionalProperties, enum, const, items, minItems, maxItems, minimum, maximum, pattern, oneOf) and then adds the checks JSON Schema cannot say: cockpit section order trip/ask/rule/say, lane order before/opening/interview/debrief, every cockpit link names a card title, card titles unique, no em-dashes.

id.description: Stable slug; keys the browser-only storage for ticks and results.

title.description: Page title and h1. Two to four words.

sub.description: One or two lines: when, who (with verification state), the job of the call.

when.description: Status-bar line before the call, e.g. 'Thu 12 Nov · 2:00 to 2:45 ET · Zoom'.

openingMinutes.description: Length of the Opening phase (identity check). Default 5.

meet.description: The meeting link, shown and copied as text.

pinned.description: The freeze note. Set it when prep is frozen; omit to hide.

qualification.description: The pre-call qualification gate (bad-actor check), required on every brief. The build refuses verdict 'go' below tier T2 or with any failed check, and renders this block as the first Before card.

tier.description: Highest trust node reached for who they are. T0 self-asserted (profile, photo, Calendly, gmail, the recruiter's word). T1 company-published (the role or person on the company's own site). T2 domain-authenticated (email or invite from the company domain, passing DMARC). T3 trusted mutual (someone you trust who knows them directly). T4 company-confirmed (the company confirms person and role through a contact you looked up yourself).

verdict.description: go: run the call. hold: ask for the missing proof and send nothing. stop: decline.

checks.description: The five stop-loss gates, each once, in order: intake, before-send, before-booking, on-call, silence.

evidence.description: What you checked and where, with the time. 'na' needs a reason.

sections.description: Stop-loss order, fixed: trip, ask, rule, say.

lede.description: One line, readable at a glance mid-call.

link.description: Exact title of the card the Details link jumps to.

lanes.description: Call order, fixed: before, opening, interview, debrief. The current phase renders first and open.

job.description: The lane's one job, one line.

footer.description: Provenance: when it was built and from which sources.

chip.description: Evidence only. STATED: someone said or wrote it. JUDGMENT: no data behind it. UNVERIFIED: claimed, not checked.

numberFrom.description: asks only: the first question number (continues the cockpit's Ask-first count).

text.description: A line to say out loud, as you would say it.

after.description: Calibration note under the table (e.g. the last Brier score).

text.description: A falsifiable prediction that resolves Hit or Miss after the call.

basis.description: Every probability says what it rests on: Stated (someone said it), Measured (counted), or Judgment (no data), then the reason.
